ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that reads multi-vendor procurement PDFs, reasons through compliance constraints using a BPMN workflow, and executes end-to-end ERP form submissions without human intervention.
ideas.title: Anakin-BPMN-Procurement-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural patterns of multi-step autonomous execution and governance seen in winning agentic workflows, directly aligning with the core judging criteria of the Anakin Forge hackathon for non-chatbot, action-taking systems.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router and web-scraping agent that evaluates live DOM structures, self-corrects extraction rules via LLM feedback loops, and cuts token costs by 40% while handling dynamic UI layouts.
ideas.title: Self-Correcting Web Extraction Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements self-improving agent mechanics and semantic routing which judges reward for hard engineering and reliability in live web navigation.

ideas.pitch: Two cooperating AI agents where one acts as an adversarial tester trying to break multi-step web forms with edge cases, while the master agent dynamically rewrites its DOM interaction strategy to succeed.
ideas.title: Adversarial UI Form-Filling Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes adversarial multi-agent dynamics that yield emergent problem-solving behaviors, a proven winner at agent-focused engineering hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol (MCP) agent designed to securely ingest clinical guidelines, navigate legacy patient intake portals, and execute multi-step form workflows autonomously.
ideas.title: MCP-Medical-Form-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases advanced protocol-level integration (MCP) which stands out to technical judges looking for structured, secure agent architectures rather than basic wrapper scripts.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first agent running locally on hardware NPUs that reads local policy documents, monitors internal web dashboards, and autonomously files compliance reports without leaking enterprise data.
ideas.title: Local NPU Regulatory Compliance Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves privacy and local-execution constraints that enterprise judges prioritize when evaluating real-world viability for autonomous agents.
